CO-CURRICULUM, ACTIVITIES

Kashmir Day on 05th February 2011.

Human Rights day 10 Dec 2011.

Cricket Match between Law and Political Science Department, which was won by the Department of Law.

Law Students Tour for Takth-Bhai & they enjoyed all the historical & archaeological sites.

Farewell and Welcome Party at Riffat Mahal, which was also attended by the Honorable Vice-Chancellor.

Students and Faculty of the Department of Law visited the Senate of Pakistan to observe the legislative proceeding in the house.

A study tour was arranged for the students to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Judicial Academy, Peshawar.

SEMINARS & SYMPOSIUMS

Workshop on “plagiarism” conducted by the Department of Law with the collaboration of NRC & HEC Islamabad.

Seminar on “IELTS” conducted by URC and the Department of Law.

Seminar on “Prisoners of War and Islam” mutually conducted by ICRC, Islamiyat and Department of Law.

Seminar on International Refugee Law was conducted the Department of Law with the collaboration of UNHCR.

Coventry University Law school & Department of Law AWKUM one-day seminar online 9
th
Nov 2021

Achievements / Honors

Six Faculty Members of Department of Law have been sent to Brunel University, the United Kingdom for a Six Weeks “Summer Refresher Programme.

Faculty members of the Department of Law participated in the
Legal Clinical Education course
at the University of Hull, UK in 2016.
